reviews.text: Amazing
Great staff and doctors!

We were so pleased with bringing our dog, Ash, here. We were feeling stressed trying to sort out the steps to get our dog to another country. Dr. Carmen kindly reassured us that they have a lot of experience helping clients out in this situation. Hayden kindly walked us through the process and provided efficient and accurate information that helped ease a lot of our anxiety. The whole office was very welcoming and helpful. They treated Ash so well. I want to express my deepest appreciation for their help and highly recommend them.
Finding PGV has been an absolute game changer for us. The vets are kind, passionate and the fear free exams make such a world of difference. I wholeheartedly recommend them!
Definitely coming long term! the staff is wonderful and very caring and pet loving !
We love point grey! They are fear free and take the time to break everything down and explain it to you,
This is the best vet clinic I’ve ever been to, I always know my dog is in safe hands, they are gentle, very knowledgable and Have beautiful energy🩷  Thanks, Christi and the team!! …

Hayden from Point Grey Veterinary Hospital has truly gone above and beyond for me and my pup, Chaplin.

We’ve been navigating a pretty unique journey getting Chaplin ready to travel back to Australia, and as anyone who has gone through international pet travel knows, there are a lot of moving parts and tiny details that really matter. Hayden has been incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and supportive throughout the entire process.

There were a few moments where unexpected things came up with paperwork and testing, and Hayden didn’t just give quick answers. They took the time to dig into it, double check things, make calls, and make sure everything was done properly. They even caught details in the documentation that could have caused serious issues with travel if they hadn’t been fixed.

As someone who likes to stay on top of things and understand every step of the process, it meant so much to have a vet who made me feel informed, supported, and genuinely cared for. Hayden’s calm approach and willingness to go the extra mile made a very stressful process feel manageable.

I’m incredibly grateful for their help and I honestly can’t recommend them enough, especially for anyone navigating pet travel or export requirements.

Thank you Hayden and the Point Grey team for taking such great care of both of us.
We’ve had such a great experience with this clinic- that staff are kind, gracious, skilled and amazing with our little kitty.

Can't say enough nice things about this vet clinic.  They took great care of our dog for many years, including those awkward Covid years.  They were always professional, clean and also very friendly and personable.  You don't have to worry about them doing the car-mechanic thing where they try to push stuff your pet doesn't need, they were always very honest with us.  I feel grateful to have called this place our vet clinic for the time we lived in Vancouver.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place to a friend or family member.

Great service
Create care
Great Managment

I will preface and say that the front desk staff, vet tech and vet are all very friendly, and I’ll probably recommend my friends who have dogs to visit them. It’s a nice place.
However, I will be seeking another place for my cats as I think either this place’s main patient target is dogs or just the doctor we saw was not that experienced with cats. We came in for a fairly common cat skin condition and the vet was very vague in her diagnosis and basically told us the same thing we searched online. They are very nice and emailed us further information, which unfortunately is also the first website showed up when we googled. The advice she gave (with an unsure tone) caused the problem to spread to the other cat we had at home. The bill is also very expensive, which reminded me of the “basic” wellbeing check she performed on them the first time that took 5 mins and over $120, and a “I can’t hear their heart because they purred so loud, but I guess she’s fine”. I really want this hospital to work because we live very close by, and maybe another doctor will be more knowledgeable, but not sure if I want to try again.

We brought our pet in and were stunned when the bill included $60 for six cotton balls. That’s $10 per cotton ball. No, this isn’t a typo. There was no surgery, no advanced care — just basic wound cleaning. The materials used were minimal, but the pricing was anything but.

This isn’t about not paying for services — it’s about transparency and fairness. We weren’t told about these charges ahead of time, and they were buried in the invoice. When questioned, we got vague explanations.

If you value honest pricing and professional integrity, I suggest looking elsewhere. This experience felt less like veterinary care and more like getting taken advantage of during a vulnerable moment.

Do better.

We have been with Point Grey since 2022 and overall are happy with their service. The only thing is that their pricing is definitely on the higher side, we’ve taken our pets to other vets in Vancouver and Toronto; Point Grey Vet is about 20 - 50% more expensive than most other vets. Other than pricing, we don’t have much to complain about, they took good care of our pets.

My dog is reactive and nervous around strangers. I booked a victory visit before the vet visit, and it was fantastic. The staff knows how to work with nervous dogs and my dog was happy go lucky when we left. The following vet visit went smoothly too. Highly recommend!

This place is amazing! I have been with Point grey vet for 17 years, the life of my dog. He was a puppy when he got his first check up here and they were the ones to put him down due to his sickness. It was the saddest day of my life but Point Grey Vet made the process comforting and smooth. They were very caring and considerate for his health throughout his lifetime. The team went above and beyond my expectations by sending this card, paw prints and fur to say goodbye to my dog, Brewster, after his passing. They didn’t have to do this because I’m no longer a customer 🤷🏻‍♀️ but they did it because they care about the animals and people 🙏🏻 Thank you looking out for every pet that walks through your doors. I would suggest this place in a heart beat! 🐕 🐈
The best vet in Vancouver!
The staff are so friendly and helpful. They go above and beyond. My dog loves going to see them.
The support staff is stellar. Could not ask for kinder people to help my pets.

Update: The owner got in touch with me. He was genuinely curious about what happened. The call went unexpectedly well, which made me want to change my rating. What happened was 1. The conversation was respectful, he asked for my feedback in detail, without making assumptions, hoping to improve the customer service of his team 2. I appreciate and respect business owners who take this degree of care into their business
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
My first experience was great; however, I encountered a difficult situation where I had to travel to the US back in June for a hike, and I wanted to make sure my dog had proper deworming medication (an oral tablet medication), so I called Point Grey a week in advance inform them that I would like the medication ready for pick up. The lady on the phone kindly told me she would prepare it for me and put it aside for pickup. Then, a week later (a day before my flight), I went to them, and the male staff told me there was never a note for me and the medication was out of stock. He then suggested that I buy an OTC brand instead, with a very I'm sorry, but I'm not here to help you attitude. Considering my flight was tomorrow, I felt like I was in a very stressful situation. Therefore, I ended up buying the OTC deworm from a pet shop, but I did a little research before I decided to put it on my dog's fur (thank god). Many reviews suggest that it is highly irritating to their pet, and they suffer insomnia and hair loss due to the intensity of the cream. So, I tossed it out; I would never use that on my little dog. I ended up going for a very light route for a hike. Since the incident, the front desk staff, mainly the male staff, has been not very friendly with me.

I highly recommend Point Grey Vet. The doctors are incredibly knowledgeable and kind. I always feel like they answer my questions and are great at explaining next steps. The support staff is particularly wonderful- they communicate regularly about updates for your pets (eg medication status, test results) and are very friendly and helpful if you call with questions. Of course, everyone is great with animals and I can tell they strive to promote a fear free, safe, and inclusive vet environment.
Thank you for the review Arne!
Thank you for the review, Teri.  You rock!!
Such lovely, kind, and caring people work here. We feel so lucky to have Lizzy looked after by this crew!! Shout out to Dr. Rebecca Burke for being so patient with us all!
Thank you Sarah for the review
Thank you Kyle
Our dog gets awesome service from all the staff and Doctors. They seem to really love animals and it shows by the care they get.
